assessment_objectives.objective: media containing sensitive and/or regulated data to be sanitized is defined.
types of sensitive and/or regulated data to be sanitized are defined.
sanitization techniques and procedures for sensitive and/or regulated data are defined.

assessment_objectives.objective: sanitization mechanisms with strength and integrity commensurate with the security category or classification of the information are employed for the sanitization of sensitive and/or regulated data.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: sanitization methods consistent with NIST media sanitization guidance for the applicable media type and data classification
